do: Pick the cell content with type: text | text 2 rows | link | diff | icon + text | icon only | checkbox | action overflow | actions icon | action text | badge | file | input (default text).
For type="badge" pass badgeLabel and badgeColor (any Badge color: neutral | brand | green | red | orange | amber | blue | purple).
Wire row actions with onEdit / onDownload / onDelete (type="actions icon"), onOverflow (type="action overflow") or onAction + actionLabel (type="action text").
dont: Don't put a Badge or Button inside a text cell by hand — use the matching type.
Don't put ad-hoc form controls in cells — use form-table-cell.

boundaries: Cells are the body of a data-table: compose them inside <TableRow> under a <TableHeaderRow> of <TableHeader> labels.

whenToUseInstead.when: the cell holds an editable form control
a simple static table with no data-table styling or cell types
